outcome: numbers of inpatient treatment days for infectious diseases
inpatient treatment episodes for infectious diseases
specialized care outpatient visits for infectious diseases
cohort: The study included all singleton live births in Finland between January 1, 2006, and December 31, 2021.
finding: Treatment-exposed children born at term and late preterm had more inpatient treatment days, episodes, and specialized care visits for infectious diseases compared to nonexposed children, while very-to-moderate preterm-born children showed similar outcomes regardless of ACT exposure.
gest_age: term (>=37 gestational weeks), very-to-moderate (<34 gestational weeks), and late (34-36 completed gestational weeks) preterm
